digest.component_or_area: CI workflows and Git fetch optimization
propositions: CI tickets-store fetch operations must apply --filter=blob:none to reduce transfer cost from multi-GB full history to sub-100 MiB blobless clones

Standalone verify-identity and Gerrit verify-identity workflows must retain fetch-depth: 0 and full commit graph while filtering blobs, and enforce pack size limits (102400 KiB and 131072 KiB respectively) via git count-objects guards
Git daemon test fixture must negotiate filter capability and verify blob:none is actually requested in wire protocol before allowing blobs to remain missing in promisor state
Production guard blocks must snapshot git count-objects before and after materialization to fail if identity scanning fetches additional objects beyond what checkout materialized
Blobless partial clone must correctly handle independent local/remote changes via merge-base and ours driver without fetching missing blobs until explicit materialization
